description: Default capability for the Beebeeb desktop windows. Targets the compact settings/app window, the first-launch onboarding window, the Windows main app window (`main-app`), and all on-demand conflict-resolution windows (label `conflict-<file_id>`, opened by the `open_conflict_window` IPC). Also covers the Windows onboarding webview (`windows-onboarding`), the tray popup (`tray`), and the macOS Settings window (`macos-settings`, slice 6 — its toolbar is a `data-tauri-drag-region`, hence start-dragging) so that event listeners and IPC commands work in all webviews.
